name: JANUS SIT1-OPEN · Stephen Hawking Dedication
dedication: Independent research tribute to Stephen Hawking's studies of physical time asymmetry and causality; does not imply his endorsement.

immutable_real_archive.telescope: Robert C. Byrd Green Bank Telescope
immutable_real_archive.selected_compute_slice: blc20 coarse subband, HDF5 rawspec.0002 lowest spectral resolution product (~50 MB each), not full 1-12 GHz nor full-resolution search
immutable_real_archive.cadence: ABACAD, six 5-minute 3I/ATLAS/3I_ATLAS_OFF scans, all same one cadence
immutable_real_archive.pointing: Scan target labels and HDF5 header coordinates are not independently authenticated antenna/ephemeris truth.
immutable_real_archive.actual_external_verification: Neither TCS/Antenna FITS logs nor independent custodian included in this open data pilot
immutable_real_archive.independence_warning: Six scans belong to a single interleaved cadence, not six independent observational challenges

numerical_adapter.frequency_policy: Select 128 contiguous original frequency channels at each fixed fractional index; do NOT fake extra frequency resolution or frequencies from filenames
numerical_adapter.time_policy: Aggregate genuine time rows into 16 equal consecutive groups by numpy array_split, averaging finite measured power (no inpainting); reject insufficient time rows
numerical_adapter.astronomical_limitation: This deterministic coarse and sparse slice is not full-band sensitivity or a validated deployment transformation
numerical_adapter.missing_or_misaligned_data: Fail closed and HOLD, no interpolation between different physical frequencies

frozen_algorithms.frozen_R42A7A_model: r42a8_ood_stress.py::frozen_model locked by checked-in artifact SHA and no retraining
frozen_algorithms.direct_strong_baseline: Independent exact SHA and forward score recomputation using frozen original functions and inputs
frozen_algorithms.research_scope: OOD diagnostic: frozen classifier trained on synthetic 16x128 panels. Application to genuine GBT data is unvalidated OOD exploratory research, not scientifically calibrated detection.

paired_design.no_unfair_observations: All three arms have identical 24 real 16x128 panels; only extra provenance sidecar metadata differs.
paired_design.source_integrity_challenges: Once 24 real windows computed, create intact and deliberately corrupted metadata manifests; no measured radio values changed.
paired_design.simulated_corruption_note: Corrupted provenance controls are simulated, their rejection is not astronomical false-alarm reduction.
paired_design.calibration: Do not assume OFF has no RFI or ON contains ETI. Without confirmed truth labels, AUROC/recall, genuine false-alarm reduction and weak signal preservation are undefined.
paired_design.detected_output_scope: Native algorithm computes exploratory paths and frozen scores only; no thresholded real science detections, no per-file FITS pointing truth
paired_design.inference_gain_test: Sidecar compared to exact direct provenance baseline for any incremental safety/cost; any claimed gain must exceed strong comparator.

gates.engineering_source_pass: Six exact verified files fetched, SHA256 recorded for each, HDF5 data/header time/frequency extracted, ON/OFF grid matched, native algorithms and pinned TACHYON actually invoked, JSON receipt + heldout control
gates.partial_failure: Record per-file HTTP/timeout/header/shape error, emit HOLD without synthetic replacement
